note: Private common IPA 728 = the delivered 727 with: the XeniaCore ABI 4 (the Xbox 360 JIT code region below 8 GB is held from RewindBox launch, so the first Xbox 360 launch no longer closes the app; a fatal reason record; the folder import opens the picked folder with security-scoped access), the Switch 2 fixes (Consoles switch: the bridge sent 1 instead of true; Files import with security-scoped access, export found up to 3 levels down, iCloud placeholder message; save import and saves folder always in the menu; centred main-menu logo; Switch-style game boxes; the fallback tile takes the margin of the active pack tiles). RPCS3 Core 934, MeloNX Core 737 and the S2Arm engine pin are kept from 727. Nothing of this build was run on an iPhone; no FPS, memory, heat or stability claim.
